Stars *not emphasis* and _underscores_ and **double**.

Dollar $5 and $x$ and a caret 2^10 and x^2^.

Equals == and plus ++ and a==b== and c++d++.

Entities as text: &amp; &#38; &copy;

| a pipe at the start
| and after a break

# not a heading
- not a list
+ not a list
1. not a list
> not a quote
: not a directive
::: not a directive either

URLs as text: www.example.com and https://example.com/path and someone@example.com.

Ids as text: PROJ-123, MY_PROJ-12, UTF-8 and (ABC-7).

Brackets [x](y) and ![alt](src) and <b>not html</b>.

Backslash \ and backtick ` and tilde ~ and ~~double~~ and ~x~.

Footnote-like [^1] and task-like [ ] and [x].
